title: Gas shortages reported after Nepal Oil resumes sale of full cylinders - The Kathmandu Post
description: Gas shortages reported after Nepal Oil resumes sale of full cylinders  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Chandrakala Paudel, a homemaker from Imadol, is worried. She has been unable to get a cooking gas cylinder and has been relying on a half-filled 7.1 kg cylinder that is about to run out.

"I have another empty cooking gas cylinder at home. I have been trying to get it refilled for the past few weeks, without success," she said. "I am really worried."

Pradeep Mahara, a bachelor's student from Kirtipur, spent an entire day on Wednesday searching for a cooking gas cylinder.

"I searched from morning to evening at every local grocery shop. Some stores were even asking for extra money to provide a cylinder," Mahara said.

"The local grocery shops said there was a shortage. They even asked for an extra Rs400," he said.

After spending the entire day searching, he eventually managed to buy a cylinder at the official price.

Like Paudel and Mahara, consumers across Nepal are struggling to obtain cooking gas cylinders despite the Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) and the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) industry insisting that supplies are normal.

Manoj Kumar Thakur, deputy director of the NOC, said that since the market has switched back to full 14.2 kg cylinders, retailers may be hoarding them while selling the remaining stock of half-filled cylinders.

"There is no problem on the supply side," he said.

The corporation resumed the distribution of full 14.2 kg cylinders on July 15. Earlier, on March 13, it had decided to distribute 7.1 kg cylinders after long queues formed at gas depots because local grocery stores were unable to supply cooking gas across the Kathmandu valley amid panic buying.

According to the state-owned oil monopoly, Nepal's monthly consumption of cooking gas is around 45,000 tonnes. However, the corporation received only 38,000 tonnes from mid-March to mid-April, 32,000 tonnes from mid-April to mid-May, 33,000 tonnes from mid-May to mid-June, and 44,544 tonnes from mid-June to mid-July.

From July 17 to July 30, another 24,000 tonnes of LPG entered the market.

"When 7.1 kg cylinders were being distributed, monthly consumption was around 32,000 to 33,000 tonnes. Now, even 45,000 tonnes is not enough after the return to 14.2 kg cylinders. This shows there is unnecessary hoarding," Thakur said.

"Cooking gas is being supplied by LPG companies and dealers, but it is being sold immediately."

He said many consumers had postponed refilling their cylinders while the 7.1 kg distribution system was in place. Once the corporation announced the resumption of 14.2 kg cylinders, a large number of empty cylinders entered the market simultaneously, sharply increasing demand.

"Once consumers receive 14.2 kg cylinders, the supply situation will return to normal. It may take a week to 10 days for the market to stabilise," Thakur said.

Industry Minister Gauri Kumari Yadav on Tuesday said current LPG supply and stocks are sufficient, adding that panic buying has put pressure on the supply chain. The ministry warned that action would be taken against anyone found creating artificial shortages or engaging in black marketing.

The corporation said the Department of Commerce, Supplies and Consumer Protection has begun market inspections, while the Kathmandu District Administration Office also started inspections on Friday. The inspections are expected to identify why consumers continue to struggle to obtain cylinders despite claims of adequate supply.

The price of a cooking gas cylinder had risen by 13 percent to Rs2,160 before declining to Rs2,060 following a fall in global fuel prices.

While the Nepal Oil Corporation expects the situation to improve within seven to 10 days, the LPG industry says it may take longer for supplies to normalise.

"During the parliamentary committee meeting held on July 15 with the industry minister, the secretary and officials from the corporation, we informed them that it would take time for supplies to normalise after shifting from 7.1 kg to 14.2 kg cylinders, even if supplies from the Indian Oil Corporation continue at the current level," said Diwan Bahadur Chand, president of the Nepal LP Gas Industry Association.

"The impact of distributing half-filled cylinders for the past four months will continue to affect supplies for some time," he said. "We need more LPG than under normal circumstances to stabilise supplies for consumers."

Chand also said the LPG industry had incurred losses because of the government's decision to distribute half-filled cylinders.

According to the association, more than 100 LPG bullets enter Nepal through southern border points every day. Each LPG bullet can fill about 1,250 cylinders, meaning around 120,000 cooking gas cylinders are currently being supplied to the market daily.

Consumer rights activists, however, allege that dealers are creating an artificial shortage to exploit consumers.

"Shopkeepers are creating an artificial shortage of cooking gas. Such shortages force consumers to pay extra to obtain cylinders," said Bishnu Prasad Timilsina, general secretary of the Forum for Protection of Consumer Rights-Nepal.

"Creating an artificial shortage of an essential commodity like cooking gas is a crime, and the government should take strict action against anyone found responsible if it truly stands with consumers," he said, adding that ensuring an uninterrupted supply of essential goods is the government's responsibility.

इमाडोल के गृहिणी चंद्रकला पौडेल चिंतित छैथ। खाना बनाबै के गैस के सिलेंडर नै मिल॑ सकलऽ छै आरू आधा भरलऽ 7.1 किलो के सिलेंडर प॑ भरोसा करी रहलऽ छै जे खतम होय वाला छै ।

ओ कहली जे घर मे एकटा आओर खाली कुकिंग गैस सिलेंडर अछि, हम पिछला किछु सप्ताह स एकरा फेर स भरबाक कोशिश मे छलहुं, मुदा सफलता नहि भेटल। "हमरा त' सत्ते चिंतित छी।"

कीर्तिपुर के स्नातक छात्र प्रदीप महरा बुधदिन पूरा दिन खाना बनाबय वाला गैस के सिलेंडर के खोज मे बिता देलखिन्ह.

महारा कहलनि जे, हम सबेरे स साँझ धरि हर स्थानीय किराना दोकान पर खोज-खोरी केलहुं, किछु स्टोर त सिलेंडर उपलब्ध कराबय लेल अतिरिक्त पैसा तक मांगि रहल छल।

ओ कहला जे स्थानीय किराना दुकान सब कहलक जे कमी अछि, ओ सब 400 टका अतिरिक्त तक मंगलक।

भरि दिन खोज मे बिता देलाक बाद अंततः ओ आधिकारिक दाम पर एकटा सिलेंडर कीनबा मे सफल भ गेलाह।

पौडेल आ महारा जकाँ नेपाल तेल निगम (एनओसी) आ तरल पेट्रोलियम गैस (एलपीजी) उद्योग आपूर्ति सामान्य पर अड़ल रहला के बादो पूरा नेपाल मे उपभोक्ता खाना बनाबय वाला गैस के सिलेंडर प्राप्त करय मे संघर्ष क रहल छथिन्ह.

एनओसी क उपनिदेशक मनोज कुमार ठाकुर कहला जे चूँकि बाजार फेर स पूरा 14.2 किलो क सिलेंडर पर आबि गेल अछि, एहि लेल खुदरा विक्रेता एकर जमाखोरी क सकैत छथि, जखन कि आधा भरल सिलेंडर क शेष स्टॉक कए बेचि रहल छथि।

ओ कहला जे आपूर्ति पक्ष मे कोनो दिक्कत नहि अछि।

निगम 15 जुलाई स पूरा 14.2 किलो सिलेंडर क वितरण फेर स शुरू केलक, एहि स पहिने 13 मार्च कए गैस डिपो मे लंबा कतार बनला क बाद 7.1 किलो सिलेंडर क वितरण करबाक फैसला केने छल, किया कि आतंकित खरीददारी क बीच स्थानीय किराना भंडार काठमांडू घाटी भर मे खाना बनाबय वाला गैस क आपूर्ति नहि क सकल छल।

सरकारी तेल एकाधिकार के अनुसार नेपाल के खाना बनाबय वाला गैस के मासिक खपत करीब 45 हजार टन अछि. मुदा निगम कए मार्च क मध्य स अप्रैल क मध्य तक मात्र 38 हजार टन, अप्रैल क मध्य स मई क मध्य तक 32 हजार टन, मई क मध्य स जून क मध्य तक 33 हजार टन आ जून क मध्य स जुलाई क मध्य तक 44,544 टन भेटल।

17 जुलाई स 30 जुलाई तक 24 हजार टन आओर एलपीजी बाजार मे आबि गेल।

ठाकुर कहला जे जखन 7.1 किलो क सिलेंडर क वितरण भ रहल छल तखन मासिक खपत करीब 32 स 33 हजार टन छल।आब 14.2 किलो सिलेंडर मे वापसी क बाद 45 हजार टन सेहो पर्याप्त नहि अछि।एहि स अनावश्यक जमाखोरी भ रहल अछि।

खाना बनाबै के गैस के आपूर्ति एलपीजी कंपनी आरू डीलर द्वारा करलौ जाय रहलौ छै, लेकिन तुरंत बेचलौ जाय रहलौ छै ।

ओ कहला जे 7.1 किलो क वितरण प्रणाली लागू रहला पर बहुतो उपभोक्ता अपन सिलेंडर मे फेर स भरब स्थगित क देलथि अछि। एक बेर निगम 14.2 किलो क सिलेंडर कए फेर स शुरू करबाक घोषणा केलक त एक संग भारी संख्या मे खाली सिलेंडर बाजार मे आबि गेल, जाहि स मांग मे भारी बढ़ोतरी भेल।

ठाकुर कहला जे उपभोक्ता कए 14.2 किलो क सिलेंडर भेटला पर आपूर्ति क स्थिति सामान्य भ जाएत, बाजार कए स्थिर हेबा मे एक सप्ताह स 10 दिन लागि सकैत अछि।

उद्योग मंत्री गौरी कुमारी यादव मंगलदिन एलपीजी के वर्तमान आपूर्ति आ स्टॉक पर्याप्त अछि आ घबराहट खरीदला स आपूर्ति श्रृंखला पर दबाव बनल बतौलनि। मंत्रालय चेतावनी देलक अछि जे जे कियो कृत्रिम कमी पैदा करैत या ब्लैक मार्केटिंग मे लागल भेटत ओकरा खिलाफ कार्रवाई कैल जाएत।

निगम वाणिज्य, आपूर्ति आ उपभोक्ता संरक्षण विभाग बजार निरीक्षण सुरु केने अछि, तहिना काठमाण्डौ जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय सेहो शुक्रदिन निरीक्षण शुरु केने अछि । उम्मीद अछि जे निरीक्षण स इ पता चलत जे पर्याप्त आपूर्ति क दावा क बावजूद उपभोक्ता कए सिलेंडर लेबा मे परेशानी किएक जारी अछि।

वैश्विक ईंधन के दाम गिरला के बाद एकटा कुकिंग गैस सिलेंडर के दाम 13 प्रतिशत बढ़ि क 2160 रुपया भ गेल छल.

नेपाल तेल निगम सात स दस दिन मे स्थिति मे सुधार हेबाक उम्मीद करैत अछि, मुदा एलपीजी उद्योग क कहब अछि जे आपूर्ति सामान्य होबय मे बेसी समय लागि सकैत अछि।

नेपाल एलपी गैस उद्योग के अध्यक्ष दीवान बहादुर चंद कहलनि जे, 15 जुलाई के उद्योग मंत्री, सचिव आ निगम के अधिकारी के संग भेल संसदीय समिति के बैसार मे हम हुनका सब के सूचित केलहुं जे 7.1 किलो के सिलेंडर सं 14.2 किलो के सिलेंडर मे स्थानांतरित भेला के बाद आपूर्ति सामान्य होबय मे समय लागत, भले ही भारतीय तेल निगम सं आपूर्ति वर्तमान स्तर पर जारी रहत संघ।

ओ कहला जे पिछला चारि मास स आधा भरल सिलेंडर क वितरण क असर किछु समय स आपूर्ति पर असर पड़त। उपभोक्ता के लेल आपूर्ति के स्थिर करय लेल हमरा सब के सामान्य परिस्थिति सं बेसी एलपीजी के जरूरत अछि।'

चांद इहो कहलनि जे सरकार के आधा भरल सिलेंडर के वितरण के फैसला के कारण एलपीजी उद्योग के नुकसान भेल अछि.

संघके अनुसार प्रतिदिन १०० सँ बेसी एलपीजी गोली दक्षिणी सीमा बिन्दुसँ नेपालमे प्रवेश करैत अछि । प्रत्येक एलपीजी गोली करीब 1250 सिलेंडर भरि सकैत अछि, मतलब एखन बाजार मे रोजाना करीब 120,000 कुकिंग गैस सिलेंडर क आपूर्ति भ रहल अछि।

उपभोक्ता अधिकार कार्यकर्ता सब के आरोप छै कि हालांकि डीलर उपभोक्ता के शोषण के लेल कृत्रिम कमी पैदा क रहल छैथ।

"दुकानदार सब खाना बनाबय वाला गैस के कृत्रिम कमी पैदा क रहल छथिन्ह." एहन कमी के कारण उपभोक्ता के सिलेंडर प्राप्त करय लेल अतिरिक्त पैसा देबय पड़ैत छनि.'' उपभोक्ता अधिकार संरक्षण मंच-नेपाल के महासचिव बिष्णुप्रसाद तिमिलसिना कहलनि।

हुनी कहलकै कि खाना बनाबै के गैस जैसनऽ आवश्यक वस्तु के कृत्रिम कमी पैदा करना अपराध छै, आरू सरकार क॑ अगर सही मायने म॑ उपभोक्ता के साथ खड़ा छै त॑ ओकरा प॑ कड़ा कार्रवाई करना चाहियऽ कि जे भी जिम्मेदार पाबैलऽ जाय छै ।

The body of Bikram Lama is finally returning home to Nepal eight months after he died homeless when camped in Hyde Park in the centre of Sydney.

After being prepared for travel by Euro Funeral Services, Mr Lama’s body began the journey home on a 8.45pm flight on Friday.

The Nepalese national migrated to Australia in 2013 to study computer science, yet more than a decade later his body lay decomposing outside St James tunnel in Hyde Park for six days before being discovered.

On Friday, the dead man’s cousin Sanjeeb Syangtan Lama provided a “final update” to the GoFundMe page which raised more than $20,000 to return him home.

Bikram Lama migrated to Australia in 2013. Picture: Supplied

He died homeless in Sydney’s Hyde Park in 2025. Picture: Supplied

Bikram Lama’s body lay decomposing out St James station in Hyde Park. Picture: Supplied.

“Today is a very emotional day for us,” he wrote.

“Bikram is finally flying home to Nepal. After more than seven months of waiting and so many difficult moments, we can finally say that he is on his way home to his family.

“I just want to say a heartfelt thank you to everyone who donated, shared the campaign, sent messages, and supported us throughout this journey.

“Your kindness and support meant so much to us, and we truly could not have done this without you.”

When Mr Lama’s body arrives at Kathmandu airport, he will then be driven via an ambulance for roughly eight hours to his remote home village in central Nepal.

Bikram Lama’s cousin Sanjeep Lama moved to Sydney in 2017, two years after Bikram. Picture: Supplied

The coroner had only released his body in early July with no cause of death identified.

The 32-year-old lay dead in a sleeping bag in December for six days with up to 100,000 people having walked past as his body began to decompose.

Mr Lama’s cousin, Sanjeeb Syangtan Lama, started a GoFundMe half way through July to cover the costs of repatriation to Nepal where he can be laid to rest by his “grieving mother”.

He described the months after his cousin died as “one of the most heartbreaking experiences any family could ever endure”.

Bikram's 73-year-old mother, Seti Maya Lama spoke about the heartbreak and confusion involved in the process. Picture: Supplied

“His family in Nepal spent months living with uncertainty, desperately hoping and praying for answers.”

The identification process was particularly difficult due to the “condition” of Mr Lama’s body, leading to a complex process of co-ordinating DNA testing from his 73-year-old mother who lived in a remote village in Nepal.

“Just imagine what that must have been like for a mother. Waiting for months, holding onto hope, only to be asked to give a DNA sample to confirm the heartbreaking truth that the son she had been waiting for would never come home alive,” Sanjeeb Syangtan Lama wrote.

title: Electric fence turning into death trap - The Rising Nepal
description: Electric fence turning into death trap  The Rising Nepal

full_article:
By Our Correspondent, Damak, July 31: An electric fence installed to protect crops from elephants has once again turned into a death trap in Mayalu Forest in Bhadrapur Municipality-4, Jhapa.

Illegal electric wires installed to protect farmland from elephant raids are increasingly posing a serious threat to human life.

At around 9:00 am on Wednesday, 65-year-old Jyoti Limbu was electrocuted after coming into contact with an exposed electric wire installed around her field to drive away elephants in the Mayalu Forest area of Bhadrapur-4.

Her daughter-in-law, Sabita Khadka, later found her lying unconscious on the ground and informed the police, according to authorities.

Ranjan Awal, spokesperson for the District Police Office, Jhapa, said an investigation into the incident had begun. He said preliminary findings indicated that Limbu died after stepping on an electrified wire installed to protect crops from elephants.

Jhapa is the district worst affected by human-elephant conflict in Nepal, with both people and wildlife losing their lives to elephant attacks every year.

In response, some farmers have been directly connecting household electricity to exposed wires to drive elephants away at night. Although such electric fencing is prohibited by law, it is still being used in rural areas.

Farmers, particularly in areas bordering India where elephants regularly enter Nepal, are forced to suffer significant annual losses.

After elephants destroy crops such as paddy, maize, bananas and sugarcane, some farmers resort to using electric wires in violation of the law, and a number of people have lost their lives after coming into contact with them.

Laws governing forest and wildlife conservation do not permit the use of fences carrying exposed electric current. Such practices are punishable because they put the lives of both people and wildlife at risk. Nevertheless, farmers in elephant-affected areas continue to resort to the measure in an attempt to protect their crops.

The area stretching from Bahundangi to Bhadrapur in Jhapa is regarded as one of Nepal’s worst-affected areas for human-elephant conflict. Herds of elephants entering from forests in India destroy crops, damage houses and sometimes cause human casualties every year, increasing fear among locals.

According to Arjun Karki, chairperson of Mechinagar Municipality Ward No. 4 and a wildlife conservationist, the number of human casualties is increasing as residents take risks by electrifying wires even around their homes to keep elephants away.

Elephants have been entering Nepal almost daily from India through Hattigauda in Bahundangi, according to locals.

More than 40 elephants have been entering Nepal, although they sometimes split into smaller groups in search of food.

Elephant researcher Shankar Luitel said more than four dozen elephants were currently roaming at different local levels in Jhapa in search of food.

title: Bhanubhakta beyond Ramayan: The other side of Nepal’s most revered poet - The Kathmandu Post
description: Bhanubhakta beyond Ramayan: The other side of Nepal’s most revered poet  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
This year’s Bhanu Jayanti came and went, as it does every year, without much controversy. The day saw celebratory poem-recitation competitions, extended morning assemblies in schools, and the general commemorations expected on the day.

Students, teachers and public figures alike spoke about Bhanubhakta’s translation of the Ramayan into Nepali and his general contributions to the language.

But 'Badhu Siksha’, Acharya’s prescriptive poem for the education of women, did not receive broad attention. In one stanza of the poem, Acharya instructs women to follow a life of devotion and service to their husbands, whom he says are no less than the gods. In another part, he warns that a woman who laughs risks becoming a beshya, a prostitute, and if not that, then risks at the least letting her house fall into disarray.

Ram Chandra Paudel, an associate professor of Nepali language and literature, who has been teaching for 25 years in Kathmandu University, shared that the poem was aimed at the wife and daughter-in-law of one of Bhanubhakta’s close friends, Tarapati. After witnessing the conflict-stricken state of Tarapati’s family affairs, he is said to have written the poem. Paudel also said that the poem is considered to be among Bhanubhakta’s minor works.

Bhushita Vasistha, a writer and researcher of Nepali and Sanskrit who recited Acharya’s ‘Badhu Sikshya’ with Nepalaya’s ‘Paleti’ in 2023, was the harshest in her criticism of the poem.

“I think the poem is degrading to women. The treatment of women in the poem is akin to that of livestock. Women are asked to contain their jealousy if their husband brings home another wife. There is no space for individuation and self-actualisation for women,” she said.

“Viewed from a modern feminist lens, there is definitely space to be critical of the poem. Nepal has always been a patriarchal society, one that is not critical of its men. Acharya does not comment on what his friend, Tarapati, himself could do better. If his house is in disarray, he must be part of the reason why, but he is not told what to do,” said Shiva Gopal Risal, an eminent professor of Nepali language and literature and author of 115 books. He was affiliated, for most of his career, with Padma Kanya Campus. Risal was among the first cohort of students to study Nepali at Tribhuvan University when it was established.

“Bhanu Bhakta’s poem is an example of the sort of education that women were given in his time. In particular, it is aimed at daughters-in-law. The prescriptions in the poem align with what many women's lives were like at the time. Even today, women might face similar expectations. Women at the time were, obviously, not going to school. They would get married off by their fathers into unfamiliar homes. At a time like that, when daughter-in-laws would have been beholden to their families, it was the only way to get by,” he added.

None of the experts were in favour of banning the work.

“People are not sheep. We need to have the courage to let people speak their mind. The sovereignty of the individual is the most important thing. We need to protect everybody’s freedom of speech,” Vasistha says.

“The poem is instructive. The mother-in-law is not the enemy of the daughter-in-law. She does not have to be cruel and suppressive, yet many mother-in-laws are. If the daughter-in-law does not protest, conflict is avoided. If she is of a nature where she won’t just take everything coming her way, there are problems. The poem is just as important today as it was when it was written. Ultimately, it teaches that women are not each other’s enemies, that they must learn to understand each other's problems,” Paudel said.

Experts also spoke of the value the poem carries.

“It is important because it is an archaeological history. It gives us rare insight into the society of the time. For example, the poem mentions Sati pratha; we learn then that Sati pratha was part of that society.” Additionally, Vasistha also praised the poem’s elegant use of meter.

“Like I said before, the poem is a living history in some ways. We are hearing the predominant opinion on these matters from a person of prominence and education in his time. Whatever one's views on the poem, it is important because it conveys some facts about society,” Risal said.

For example, in one part, the poem speaks of treating the members of the family to raisins, cashews and almonds. In another part, the poem speaks of how servants are to be dealt with. These lines tell readers that Tarapati would have been a rich man, that he had servants in his household and that people of his social class would have considered raisins, cashews and almonds to be special treats.

“The reason for this is the same as why Nepal’s bureaucracy has so many problems. People respect authority beyond reason. Acharya is a canonised figure in Nepal. People are not comfortable with criticising someone with the moniker of Adikavi”, Vasistha said.

Paudel shared that many of his students were unaware of who Bhanubhakta was, let alone be familiar with a minor work of his like ‘Badhu Sikshya’. Of readers who were familiar, he shared that readers were both respectful of his contributions and, in their place, critical of the poem for the same reasons that he was.

“With time, older ideas are challenged and fall out of fashion, the same thing is happening with ‘Badhu Sikshya', and it will continue to happen. This is not an extraordinary matter,” said Risal.

title: In the Songs of Blood and Sword ‘Baloch aspired to be as independent as Nepal’ - Khabarhub
description: In the Songs of Blood and Sword ‘Baloch aspired to be as independent as Nepal’  Khabarhub

full_article:
Severe tensions in Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Pakistan-administered Kashmir (PAK) have created a situation akin to a civil war, although a civil war has not been formally declared in Pakistan. The southwestern province of Pakistan has been in conflict for decades, and a document allegedly issued in the name of the ‘Republic of Balochistan’ has spurred new discussions.

Reportedly, eighty-five percent of the regions are under the authority of Baloch who have declared their independence. Nevertheless, the assertions stated in the purported independence paper have not yet been independently confirmed. Since 2003, there has been persistent unrest and separatist movements in Balochistan, driven by demands for independence and autonomy. The Baloch people have a distinct language and culture. They feel neglected by Pakistan’s Punjabi-dominated political and military establishment.

Fatima Bhutto’s book ‘Songs of Blood and Sword’ offers an engrossing historical narrative of the Baloch people’s quest for independence from Pakistan and Balochistan as a separate nation similar to Nepal. This book is mainly based on the epic story of the Bhuttos, a family of wealthy feudal landlords who rose to prominence in the newly formed state of Pakistan, is told in Songs of Blood and Sword.

It is the story of four generations of a family and the political violence that would ultimately kill them. Written by someone who has experienced it, it is the story of a family and country torn apart by murder, corruption, conspiracy, and division.

Published in 2010, this 470-page book provides a contemporary perspective on history and how it impacts the military’s political ambitions in Pakistan. Overall, this book is useful for comprehending Pakistan’s future status and course.

Independent like Nepal

Pakistan has had a significant impact on the province of Balochistan. Depending on who you ask, the Baloch people, who are tribal in their formation and groupings, are claimed to have Semitic or Iranian ancestry. Those who speak Balochi or one of the other regional languages assert that they left their lives as shepherds in Syria sometime in the first millennium and travelled nomadically throughout Central Asia before settling in the Baloch province, while those who identify linguistically with Aryans across the border claim Persian ancestry.

Shahbaz Sharif, the “de jure Prime Minister,” appears to be compelled to behave in accordance with the Pakistan Army’s strategic roadmap. Can the Pakistani elite— have suffered the anguish of Pakistan’s disintegration, stop the Baloch independence movement? Can it alleviate the severe annoyances that the people of PoK and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are expressing?

Fatima Bhutto, in her book, discusses the independent status of ‘Nepal’ in the context of discussing the Baloch under Pakistan. For decades, Balochistanis have been fighting for independence from Pakistan, even today. During the British Raj, Balochistan was part of the Mughal, Persian, and Afghan kingdoms and was culturally, linguistically, and ethnically integrated with their populations.

By the nineteenth century, most of the four princely states there had been brought under the rule of the British Raj. Wars and imperialist struggles consolidated the large region now known as Balochistan, a province rich in mineral resources. When the subcontinent began to break up, the question was asked: where did they want to go?

The Baloch voted for neither India nor Pakistan – we wanted to be “independent like Nepal” (page 115). But for some time, Balochistan was ruled by princes there, whom the Pakistani government, which sent troops and forced them to sign an agreement with Mir Ahmad Yar Khan, the prince of Kalat, to renounce Balochistan’s claim to independence.

Fatima also mentions the context of a conversation she had with Khair Bux Mari, a Baloch leader from Pakistan’s Baloch province, to complete the prose of the book. Khair Bux, representing the Baloch spirit of independence, said, ‘Very few countries are independent. But Pakistan is still a colony of the British and American imperialists. How can there be an independent view of the colony?’

Geopolitics of that time

In the 1950s, Pakistan, like many other nations, was mired in the quagmire of the Cold War. Even then, the military junta that ruled Pakistan’s politics did not consider neutrality or non-alignment an option. On 7 October 1958, General Ayub Khan seized power from President Iskander Mirza in a “surprise coup”. The illegitimate seizure of power came at a time of great chaos and political uncertainty within Pakistan, leading most Pakistanis to resent the general’s takeover.

At the age of 30, Zulfikar Bhutto joined the then government as Minister of Fuel, Energy and Natural Resources. In 1960, Zulfikar was entrusted with the sensitive task of negotiating an oil deal with the Soviet Union. Zulfikar’s visit resulted in a loan of 120 million rubles to fund further oil exploration within Pakistan, and a promise from the Soviet Union to supply experienced experts and equipment for the program.

Meanwhile, Pakistan’s relations with the Soviet Union were slowly becoming difficult due to the Pakistani regime’s insistence on siding with the United States. As it was, Pakistan’s military dictators tended to embrace any power that promised to protect them. The then Pakistani military also saw the United States as the most enabling force for its militarism.

Already effectively modernizing its military, Pakistan signed a Mutual Defense Agreement with the United States in 1954. As part of the agreement, Pakistan was encouraged to join the Southeast Asian Treaty Organization in September 1954 and later the Central Treaty Organization in 1955. Although bilateral relations were the focus of Zulfikar’s foreign policy, there was no easy way to ignore the fact that relations between Pakistan and China had seriously deteriorated under General Ayub.

The general was constantly pushing China out to make room for the US, and against China’s wishes, relations with the US took a sharp turn in 1963, when Zulfiqar, seen as the architect of Pakistan’s bilateral foreign policy, took over as foreign minister. In 1962, anticipating Pakistan’s potential relationship with China and the young foreign minister’s socialist leanings, the US transferred Rs 300 million from the State Bank of Pakistan to a counterpart fund to begin extending credit to US commercial banks operating inside Pakistan, which was seen as a clear warning to Pakistan.

The forces that see Bangladesh through the eyes of East Pakistan are not only in present-day Pakistan but also the foreign friends of the Field Marshal. The main opposition party to the Awami League is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, whose historical roots are in deep alliances with the Islamist party Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and whose roots have been in Pakistan since 1971.

Zulfikar’s Radical Thought vs. Zia’s Junta

Zulfikar was facing setbacks towards the end of his political reign. Henry Kissinger, who publicly described Zulfikar as a capable and intelligent politician, gave him a major reprimand for advancing Pakistan’s nuclear ambitions. Zulfikar amended the 1973 constitution several times, allowing the federal government to ban political parties.

He curbed the power of the judiciary. In an effort to secure his political position, Zulfikar amended the constitution to define the criteria for ‘who is a Muslim?’ and made peace with the small but powerful religious parties out of fear. He banned alcohol and drove the entertainment industry underground.

He declared Friday prayers a public holiday. In 1974, Zulfikar organized the second summit of Islamic countries, which Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, alias Shah-of-Iran, was not ready to attend, and Idi Amin arrived uninvited.

While declaring the success of the summit, which was attended by 38 Islamic countries, Zulfikar had said, ‘We Pakistan will give our blood for Islam.’ Pakistan will not let any Islamic country in the world feel a lack of support. However, nothing like that happened. When the US attacked Pakistan’s neighbors Iran and Afghanistan, Pakistan humbly opened its skies. Fatima says – If Zulfikar were alive, he would have felt disgusted by Pakistan’s move.

In 1976, when General Tikka Khan, known as the “Butcher of Bengal”, was retiring from the army, Zulfikar replaced him with Zia-ul-Haq, bypassing the five senior generals. Zulfikar considered Zia to be his subordinate, although Zia was cunning, ambitious and cruel.

General Zia began to develop the judiciary in favor of the junta (a military or political group that rules a country after seizing power by force).

After widespread political unrest and allegations of electoral fraud following the 1977 general elections, General Zia led a military coup and overthrew the democratically elected government of Bhutto.

By 1979, judges who showed a lack of enthusiasm for the military in the government were quickly dismissed and replaced.

Sharia courts and military tribunals were created to enforce the regime’s orders, along with the curtailment of the powers of civilian courts. Zia’s rule was not only extremely brutal, it introduced the practice of public flogging and hanging, and made the five-time daily prayer mandatory in all offices, business places, and schools in Pakistan.

Despite national and international appeals for clemency, the Supreme Court upheld the death sentence in 1979. When Zulfiqar was sentenced to death, a demonstration against the newly introduced party-less Panchayat system in Nepal turned into a large rally, with students marching towards the Pakistani embassy in Kathmandu. Zulfiqar’s hanging is often cited as a political event in the history of Nepal’s referendums.

Allah, Army, and Adalat

Without addressing the political appetites of the Pakistani Army, no understanding of Pakistan and its politics would be complete. A popular narrative about Pakistan is— the army rules the country and seizes control of the courts in the name of Allah. Last year, the 27th Amendment to the Pakistani constitution brought in some serious changes, granting expanded powers to the Pakistani Army and its top leadership, especially the army chief.

Pakistan is a country that can still be seen engaged in a ‘wrestling of selfishness’, whether it is used or abused by the superpowers. Even though Pakistan’s Prime Minister is Shahbaz Sharif, the reins of power have been under the control of the Pakistani Army.

Shahbaz Sharif, the “de jure Prime Minister,” appears to be compelled to behave in accordance with the Pakistan Army’s strategic roadmap. Can the Pakistani elite— have suffered the anguish of Pakistan’s disintegration, stop the Baloch independence movement? Can it alleviate the severe annoyances that the people of PoK and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are expressing?

Ultimately, it appears from reading Fatima’s book that the melodies of blood and sword are once again resonating with Pakistan’s current internal turmoil!

बलूचिस्तान, खैबर पख्तूनख्वा, आरू पाकिस्तान प्रशासित कश्मीर (पीएके) मँ भयंकर तनाव के वजह स॑ गृहयुद्ध जैसनऽ स्थिति पैदा होय गेलऽ छै, हालांकि पाकिस्तान म॑ औपचारिक रूप स॑ गृहयुद्ध के घोषणा नै करलऽ गेलऽ छै । पाकिस्तान केरऽ दक्षिण-पश्चिमी प्रांत दशकऽ स॑ टकराव म॑ छै, आरू कथित तौर प॑ ‘बलूचिस्तान गणराज्य’ के नाम प॑ जारी एगो दस्तावेज न॑ नया चर्चा के प्रेरणा देल॑ छै ।

खबर छै कि पचासी प्रतिशत क्षेत्र बलूच के अधिकार में छै जे अपनऽ आजादी के घोषणा करी चुकलऽ छै । एकरऽ बावजूद कथित स्वतंत्रता पत्र म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ दावा के अखनी तलक स्वतंत्र रूप स॑ पुष्टि नै होय सकलऽ छै । 2003 स॑ बलूचिस्तान म॑ लगातार अशांति आरू अलगाववादी आन्दोलन जारी छै, जे आजादी आरू स्वायत्तता के मांग स॑ संचालित छै । बलूच लोकक एकटा अलग भाषा आ संस्कृति अछि । पाकिस्तान केरऽ पंजाबी बहुल राजनीतिक आरू सैन्य संस्थापन द्वारा हुनका उपेक्षित महसूस होय छै ।

फातिमा भुट्टो केरऽ पुस्तक ‘रक्त आरू तलवार के गीत’ म॑ बलूच लोगऽ के नेपाल जैसनऽ अलग राष्ट्र के रूप म॑ पाकिस्तान आरू बलूचिस्तान स॑ आजादी के खोज के मनमोहक ऐतिहासिक कथ्य प्रस्तुत करलऽ गेलऽ छै । ई पुस्तक मुख्य रूप स॑ भूट्टो केरऽ महाकाव्य कहानी प॑ आधारित छै, जे नवगठित पाकिस्तान राज्य म॑ प्रमुखता हासिल करै वाला धनी सामंती जमींदारऽ के परिवार छेकै, जेकरा खून आरू तलवार के गीत म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ई एकटा परिवार के चारि पीढ़ी के कहानी छै आरू राजनीतिक हिंसा के कहानी छै जे अंततः ओकरऽ जान लेतै । जे कियो अनुभव केने छथि हुनका लिखल ई हत्या, भ्रष्टाचार, षड्यंत्र, आ बंटवारा सँ फाटल परिवार आ देशक कथा अछि ।

2010 म॑ प्रकाशित ई 470 पन्ना केरऽ ई पुस्तक इतिहास केरऽ समकालीन परिप्रेक्ष्य प्रदान करै छै आरू एकरऽ प्रभाव पाकिस्तान म॑ सेना केरऽ राजनीतिक महत्वाकांक्षा प॑ केना पड़ै छै । कुल मिला क॑ ई पुस्तक पाकिस्तान केरऽ भविष्य केरऽ स्थिति आरू कोर्स क॑ समझै लेली उपयोगी छै ।

नेपाल सन निर्दलीय

पाकिस्तान केरऽ बलूचिस्तान प्रांत प॑ काफी असर पड़लऽ छै । केकरा स पूछब ताहि पर बलूच लोक जे अपन गठन आ समूहीकरण मे आदिवासी छथि, हुनका सेमिटिक या ईरानी मूल के दावा कयल जाइत अछि | बलूची या अन्य क्षेत्रीय भाषा म॑ स॑ कोय भाषा बोलै वाला लोगऽ के कहना छै कि वू लोगऽ न॑ पहिलऽ सहस्राब्दी म॑ कहियो सीरिया म॑ चरवाहा के रूप म॑ अपनऽ जीवन छोड़ी क॑ बलूच प्रांत म॑ बसै स॑ पहल॑ पूरा मध्य एशिया म॑ खानाबदोश रूप स॑ यात्रा करलकै, जबकि जे लोग सीमा पार के आर्य के साथ भाषाई रूप स॑ पहचान करै छै, वू फारसी वंश के दावा करै छै ।

“डी जूर प्रधानमंत्री” शाहबाज शरीफ पाकिस्तान सेना केरऽ रणनीतिक रोडमैप के अनुसार व्यवहार करै लेली मजबूर नजर आबी रहलऽ छै । की पाकिस्तानी अभिजात वर्ग— पाकिस्तान केरऽ विघटन केरऽ पीड़ा भोगी चुकलऽ छै, बलूच स्वतंत्रता आन्दोलन क॑ रोकी सकै छै ? की ई पोक आ खैबर पख्तूनख्वा के लोक जे गंभीर परेशानी व्यक्त क रहल छथिन्ह ओकरा कम क सकैत अछि?

फातिमा भुट्टो, अपनऽ पुस्तक म॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ अधीन बलूच केरऽ चर्चा के संदर्भ म॑ ‘नेपाल’ केरऽ स्वतंत्र दर्जा के चर्चा करल॑ छै । दशकों स बलूचिस्तानी पाकिस्तान स आजादी क लड़ाई लड़ि रहल अछि, आइयो। ब्रिटिश राज के दौरान बलूचिस्तान मुगल, फारसी आरू अफगान राज्य के हिस्सा छेलै आरू सांस्कृतिक, भाषाई आरू जातीय रूप स॑ ओकरऽ आबादी के साथ एकीकृत छेलै ।

उन्नीसवीं सदी तक ओतय के चारि रियासत में स अधिकांश राज्य ब्रिटिश राज के शासन में आनल गेल छल | युद्ध आरू साम्राज्यवादी संघर्ष न॑ ई बड़ऽ क्षेत्र क॑ मजबूत करी देलकै जेकरा अखनी बलूचिस्तान के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय छै, जे खनिज संसाधन स॑ भरपूर प्रांत छेकै । जखन उपमहाद्वीप टूटय लागल त सवाल पूछल गेल जे ओ सब कतय जाय चाहैत छल?

बलूच ने भारत के वोट देलक आ ने पाकिस्तान के – हम सब “नेपाल जकाँ स्वतंत्र” बनय चाहैत छलहुं (पृष्ठ 115)। लेकिन कुछ समय तलक बलूचिस्तान प॑ वहाँ के राजकुमारऽ के शासन छेलै, जेकरा प॑ पाकिस्तानी सरकार न॑ सैनिक भेजलकै आरू ओकरा सब क॑ कलात केरऽ राजकुमार मीर अहमद यार खान के साथ बलूचिस्तान केरऽ आजादी के दावा के त्याग करै लेली समझौता करै लेली मजबूर करी देलकै ।

फातिमा न॑ ई पुस्तक केरऽ गद्य क॑ पूरा करै लेली पाकिस्तान केरऽ बलूच प्रांत केरऽ बलूच नेता खैर बक्स मारी स॑ करलऽ गेलऽ बातचीत के संदर्भ के भी जिक्र करै छै । आजादी केरऽ बलूच भावना के प्रतिनिधित्व करतें खैर बक्स न॑ कहलकै कि ‘बहुत कम देश स्वतंत्र छै । मुदा पाकिस्तान एखनो ब्रिटिश आ अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवादीक उपनिवेश अछि । उपनिवेशक स्वतंत्र दृष्टिकोण कोना भ’ सकैत अछि?’

तत्कालीन भूराजनीति

1950 के दशक में पाकिस्तान भी बहुत सारा अन्य राष्ट्र के तरह शीत युद्ध के दलदल में डूबी गेलऽ छेलै । तखनो पाकिस्तान केरऽ राजनीति प॑ राज करै वाला सैन्य जुंटा तटस्थता या गैर-गठबंधन क॑ विकल्प नै मानलकै । ७ अक्टूबर १९५८ क॑ जनरल अयूब खान न॑ राष्ट्रपति इस्कंदर मिर्जा स॑ “आश्चर्यजनक तख्तापलट” करी क॑ सत्ता हथिया लेलकै । सत्ता पर नाजायज कब्जा पाकिस्तान के भीतर बहुत अराजकता आरू राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता के समय म॑ आबी गेलऽ छेलै, जेकरा चलतें अधिकांश पाकिस्तानी जनरल केरऽ अधिग्रहण स॑ नाराजगी जतैलकै ।

30 वर्षक उम्र मे जुल्फीकर भुट्टो तत्कालीन सरकार मे ईंधन, ऊर्जा आ प्राकृतिक संसाधन मंत्रीक रूप मे शामिल भ गेलाह। 1960 म॑ जुल्फीकर क॑ सोवियत संघ के साथ तेल सौदा करै के संवेदनशील काम सौंपलऽ गेलै । जुल्फीकर केरऽ ई यात्रा के परिणामस्वरूप पाकिस्तान के भीतर तेल केरऽ आरू खोज लेली फंडिंग लेली १२ करोड़ रूबल के ऋण मिललै, आरू सोवियत संघ स॑ ई कार्यक्रम लेली अनुभवी विशेषज्ञ आरू उपकरण के आपूर्ति के वादा करलऽ गेलै ।

एम्हर पाकिस्तानी शासन केरऽ अमेरिका के पक्ष लेबै के जिद के कारण सोवियत संघ के साथ पाकिस्तान केरऽ संबंध धीरे-धीरे मुश्किल होय रहलऽ छेलै । जेना कि छल, पाकिस्तान के सैन्य तानाशाह कोनो एहन शक्ति के अपनाबय के प्रवृत्ति रखैत छलाह जे हुनका सुरक्षा के वादा करय. तत्कालीन पाकिस्तानी सेना भी अमेरिका क॑ अपनऽ सैन्यवाद लेली सबसें सक्षम बनाबै वाला ताकत के रूप म॑ देखै छेलै ।

पहिने स॑ ही अपनऽ सेना क॑ प्रभावी ढंग स॑ आधुनिक बनाबै वाला पाकिस्तान न॑ १९५४ म॑ अमेरिका के साथ आपसी रक्षा समझौता प॑ हस्ताक्षर करलकै ।ई समझौता के हिस्सा के तौर प॑ पाकिस्तान क॑ सितंबर १९५४ म॑ दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई संधि संगठन आरू बाद म॑ १९५५ म॑ केंद्रीय संधि संगठन म॑ शामिल होय लेली प्रोत्साहित करलऽ गेलै ।हालांकि द्विपक्षीय संबंध जुल्फीकर केरऽ विदेश नीति केरऽ केंद्र बिंदु छेलै, लेकिन एकरा नजरअंदाज करै के कोय आसान तरीका नै छेलै ई तथ्य कि जनरल अयूब केरऽ समय म॑ पाकिस्तान आरू चीन के बीच संबंध गंभीर रूप स॑ खराब होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

जनरल चीन क॑ लगातार अमेरिका लेली जगह बनाबै लेली बाहर धकेल॑ रहलऽ छेलै आरू चीन केरऽ इच्छा के खिलाफ १९६३ म॑ अमेरिका के साथ संबंध म॑ तेज मोड़ आबी गेलै, जब॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ द्विपक्षीय विदेश नीति केरऽ शिल्पकार के रूप म॑ देखलऽ जाय वाला जुल्फिकार न॑ विदेश मंत्री के पद संभाली लेलकै । 1962 म॑ चीन के साथ पाकिस्तान केरऽ संभावित संबंध आरू युवा विदेश मंत्री केरऽ समाजवादी झुकाव के पूर्वानुमान लगाबैत॑ हुअ॑ अमेरिका न॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ स्टेट बैंक स॑ 30 करोड़ रुपया क॑ एक समकक्ष कोष म॑ हस्तांतरित करी क॑ पाकिस्तान के भीतर संचालित अमेरिकी वाणिज्यिक बैंकऽ क॑ ऋण देना शुरू करी देलकै, जेकरा पाकिस्तान लेली एगो स्पष्ट चेतावनी के रूप म॑ देखलऽ गेलै ।

पूर्वी पाकिस्तान के नजर स॑ बंगलादेश क॑ देखै वाला ताकत खाली वर्तमान पाकिस्तान म॑ ही नै छै बल्कि फील्ड मार्शल केरऽ विदेशी दोस्त भी छै । अवामी लीग केरऽ मुख्य विपक्षी दल बांग्लादेश राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी छेकै, जेकरऽ ऐतिहासिक जड़ इस्लामिक पार्टी बांग्लादेश जमात-ए-इस्लामी के साथ गहरा गठबंधन म॑ छै आरू जेकरऽ जड़ १९७१ स॑ पाकिस्तान म॑ छै ।

जुल्फिकर के कट्टरपंथी विचार बनाम जिया के जुंटा |

जुल्फीकर क॑ अपनऽ राजनीतिक शासन के अंत के तरफ असफलता के सामना करना पड़॑ लगलऽ छेलै । हेनरी किसिंजर, जे सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ जुल्फिकर क॑ एगो सक्षम आरू बुद्धिमान राजनीतिज्ञ बतैलकै, न॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ परमाणु महत्वाकांक्षा क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै लेली हुनका एगो बड़ऽ डांट देलकै । जुल्फीकर 1973 के संविधान में कई बेर संशोधन केलक, जाहि में संघीय सरकार राजनीतिक दल पर रोक लगाबय के अनुमति देलक।

न्यायपालिकाक सत्ता पर लगाम लगा देलनि। अपनऽ राजनीतिक स्थिति सुरक्षित करै के कोशिश म॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ संविधान म॑ संशोधन करी क॑ ‘मुसलमान के छै?’ के मापदंड परिभाषित करलकै आरू डर स॑ छोटऽ लेकिन शक्तिशाली धार्मिक दलऽ स॑ शांति करलकै । ओ शराब पर रोक लगा देलनि आ मनोरंजन उद्योग के भूमिगत भगा देलखिन्ह.

शुक्रवार के नमाज के सार्वजनिक छुट्टी घोषित क देलखिन। १९७४ म॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ इस्लामी देशऽ के दोसरऽ शिखर सम्मेलन के आयोजन करलकै, जेकरा म॑ मोहम्मद रेजा पहलवी उर्फ ​​ईरान केरऽ शाह, भाग लेबै लेली तैयार नै छेलै, आरू इदी अमीन बिना आमंत्रित के पहुँची गेलै ।

३८ इस्लामिक देशऽ न॑ भाग लेन॑ वाला ई शिखर सम्मेलन के सफलता के घोषणा करतें हुअ॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ कहलकै कि ‘हम पाकिस्तान इस्लाम लेली अपनऽ खून देबै ।’ पाकिस्तान दुनिया केरऽ कोय भी इस्लामी देश क॑ समर्थन के कमी नै महसूस करै देतै । ओना एहन किछु नहि भेल। जखन अमेरिका पाकिस्तान के पड़ोसी देश ईरान आ अफगानिस्तान पर हमला केलक त पाकिस्तान विनम्रता सं अपन आसमान खोललक. फातिमा कहैत छथि – जँ जुल्फीकर जीवित रहितथि त’ पाकिस्तानक एहि कदम सँ हुनका घृणा होइतनि ।

1976 मे जखन जनरल टिक्का खान जे “बंगाल क कसाई” क नाम स जानल जाइत छलाह तखन सेना स रिटायर भ रहल छलाह त जुल्फीकर हुनकर जगह जिया उल हक कए पांचटा वरिष्ठ जनरल कए बाईपास करि देलथि । जुल्फीकर जिया के अपनऽ अधीनस्थ मानलकै, हालांकि जिया धूर्त, महत्वाकांक्षी आरू क्रूर छेलै ।

जनरल जिया न्यायपालिका के विकास जुंटा (एक सैन्य या राजनीतिक समूह जे जबरदस्ती सत्ता पर कब्जा करला के बाद कोनो देश पर शासन करै छै) के पक्ष में करै लगलै ।

१९७७ केरऽ आम चुनाव के बाद व्यापक राजनीतिक अशांति आरू चुनावी धोखाधड़ी के आरोप के बाद जनरल जिया न॑ सैन्य तख्तापलट के नेतृत्व करी क॑ लोकतांत्रिक तरीका स॑ चुनलऽ भुट्टो सरकार क॑ उखाड़ फेंकलकै ।

1979 तक सरकार मे सेना क प्रति उत्साह क कमी देखनिहार जज कए जल्दीए बर्खास्त क देल गेल आ हुनकर जगह पर राखल गेल।

शासन केरऽ आदेश क॑ लागू करै लेली शरीयत कोर्ट आरू सैन्य ट्रिब्यूनल के निर्माण करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, साथ ही सिविल कोर्ट केरऽ अधिकार म॑ कटौती भी करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । जिया केरऽ शासन न सिर्फ अत्यंत क्रूर छेलै, बल्कि सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ कोड़ा मारना आरू फांसी केरऽ प्रथा शुरू करी देलकै, आरू पाकिस्तान केरऽ सब कार्यालय, व्यापारिक जगह, आरू स्कूल म॑ रोजाना पांच बार नमाज पढ़ना अनिवार्य करी देलकै ।

दया केरऽ राष्ट्रीय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अपील के बावजूद सुप्रीम कोर्ट न॑ १९७९ म॑ फांसी के सजा क॑ बरकरार रखलकै । जुल्फिकर क॑ जब॑ फाँसी के सजा सुनवाय देलऽ गेलै त॑ नेपाल म॑ नवका शुरू करलऽ गेलऽ पार्टी-रहित पंचायत प्रणाली के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन एगो बड़ऽ रैली म॑ बदली गेलै, जेकरा म॑ छात्रऽ न॑ काठमांडू म॑ पाकिस्तानी दूतावास के तरफ मार्च करलकै । जुल्फिकार केरऽ फांसी क॑ अक्सर नेपाल केरऽ जनमत संग्रह के इतिहास म॑ एगो राजनीतिक घटना के रूप म॑ उद्धृत करलऽ जाय छै ।

अल्लाह, सेना, आ अदालत

पाकिस्तानी सेना केरऽ राजनीतिक भूख क॑ संबोधित करला के बिना पाकिस्तान आरू ओकरऽ राजनीति केरऽ कोय भी समझ पूरा नै होतै । पाकिस्तान के बारे में एगो लोकप्रिय कथ्य छै— सेना देश पर राज करै छै आरू अल्लाह के नाम पर कोर्टऽ पर नियंत्रण कब्जा करी लै छै । पिछला साल पाकिस्तानी संविधान मँ 27वां संशोधन मँ कुछ गंभीर बदलाव आबी गेलै, जेकरा मँ पाकिस्तानी सेना आरू ओकरौ शीर्ष नेतृत्व खास करी क सेना प्रमुख क विस्तारित अधिकार मिललै ।

पाकिस्तान एगो ऐसनऽ देश छै जेकरा अखनी भी ‘स्वार्थ केरऽ कुश्ती’ म॑ जुटलऽ देखलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै, चाहे ओकरऽ उपयोग महाशक्ति सिनी द्वारा करलऽ जाय या दुरुपयोग करलऽ जाय । पाकिस्तान केरऽ प्रधानमंत्री शाहबाज शरीफ भले ही सत्ता केरऽ बागडोर पाकिस्तानी सेना के नियंत्रण म॑ रहलऽ छै ।

“डी जूर प्रधानमंत्री” शाहबाज शरीफ पाकिस्तान सेना केरऽ रणनीतिक रोडमैप के अनुसार व्यवहार करै लेली मजबूर नजर आबी रहलऽ छै । की पाकिस्तानी अभिजात वर्ग— पाकिस्तान केरऽ विघटन केरऽ पीड़ा भोगी चुकलऽ छै, बलूच स्वतंत्रता आन्दोलन क॑ रोकी सकै छै ? की ई पोक आ खैबर पख्तूनख्वा के लोक जे गंभीर परेशानी व्यक्त क रहल छथिन्ह ओकरा कम क सकैत अछि?

अंततः फातिमा केरऽ किताब पढ़ला स॑ पता चलै छै कि खून आरू तलवार केरऽ धुन एक बार फेरू पाकिस्तान केरऽ वर्तमान आंतरिक उथल-पुथल के साथ गुंजायमान होय ​​रहलऽ छै !

title: Nepal's biggest export to India: Instagram reels - Nepali Times
description: Nepal's biggest export to India: Instagram reels  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
A clip from Kathmandu, September 2025. A young man plants himself in front of a police water cannon, letting the water jet smash into him. Ten months later the same frame is circulating in Indian feeds as fan art, recoloured and captioned: Let's go Indian GenZ.

However many in India, including the Cockroach Janta Party, have tried to say that what happened there this month is fundamentally different from Nepal, Bangladesh or Sri Lanka, there are parallels. Especially in the world of memes.

Several genres of reels have gone across the border. In one, an Indian creator walks through Kathmandu praising the civic sense of Nepalis as evidence about his own country’s failures.

In another, a Nepali creator films an Indian tourist cooking on a Pokhara footpath and holds him up as evidence for Indian tourists polluting Nepal.

The same message is coming from opposite directions. Both do the same work — for a certain kind of Indian content creator tourist visiting Pokhara, Nepal is not just a neighbour but a reference image in the feed.

Seventy-six Nepalis died in September 2025. In Delhi's CJP protests there were batons, tear gas, detentions and a 26-day hunger strike, but no one was killed although dozens of earlier suicides were blamed on leaked NEET exam papers.

What interests me is the trade route. Nepal's actual exports to India move through Birganj. They queue at customs, get weighed, pay, and wait. But an Instagram reel crosses in a fraction of a second, pays no duty, needs no transit agreement, and clears Raxaul without anyone at the border knowing it happened.

The only party taking a cut is the Dalal - Meta™. And Meta Sahib takes it in attention rather than rupees. This is the most efficient smuggler on the virtual border between India and Nepal, and the products are memes and meme formats.

During the September protests I made a meme setting the 'who was interested in each other first?' TikTok sound, normally a couples' bit, against a line of riot police. It did about 2 million views. The same sound turned up on Indian feeds this summer, pointed at the same target.

I made one of these, so I know exactly how little effort it takes and how far it goes. The Subway Surfers chase edit crossed too. So did the water cannon. Memes are meant to be shared, remixed, and redistributed. Yet what memes are redistributed, remixed or shared tells us more than the likes, comments or shares.

SUMMONS AND DRILLS

In Nepal, the memes were about showing up, and most of them were made after showing up. The aura shot in front of the water cannon. The silhouette against the burning building. What spread hardest was footage of arrival, of bodies present where they were not supposed to be. Our meme was a summons.

Jantar Mantar in Delhi had a lot of them too. But there was a second layer. Indian memes were also about dodging: how to take a water cannon, finding loopholes so that the police do not beat you. One meme was cut like a film scene, captioned: ‘Me at the protest saving a 10/10 baddie from the water cannon’, showing a hero pulling the heroine clear of the water cannon, saving her from the state’s violence.

That is what watching a neighbour gets you. India's youth did not only replicate our memes, they studied our footage and worked out what a protest against the government actually requires.

COSTUME AND INSIGNIA

Jantar Mantar had Superman, Spider-Man and at least one T-Rex. It had a man dressed as Mahatma Gandhi captioned 'wild card entry', on the joke that things had got bad enough for Gandhi to come back from the dead and protest. That post got 600,000 likes. People carried printed memes as placards.

Kathmandu had the skull-and-bones and straw hat. Straw hats turned up at Jantar Mantar, but as guests. They were not the host language. The costumed appearances were individual bits, each its own post, each competing with the others.

AURA ECONOMY

There is a name for this: aura farming. It works for the movement, in the crudest possible way. An outrageous costume at the protest trends. Trending brings traction. Traction brings the next crowd. The joke is load-bearing.

Look at what it costs, though. The T-Rex flattens the thing it is standing inside. What happened at Jantar Mantar was a generation revolting against a system that has failed it for years and buried some of its peers. In costume, it is photographed as a festival. And people who arrive having seen a festival come to film one.

I think it’s important to understand that we underestimate how badly the young want to go viral. Ask any gen-alpha kid what they want to be when they grow up - they will most likely say vlogger, youtuber, or gamer. This week three Nepali tots walking from school in colourful raincoats were filmed on TikTok, went viral, and they were handed scholarships.

Virality is no longer only social capital. It is a working economic instrument, and for a lot of young people it is the only one available without connections.

That pull gets people to dance in front of a camera. It gets them to say outrageous things on livecam. It is not why anyone marched on Sansad Marg last month or in Baneswor last year. But it was somewhere in the mix, which tells you something about my generation worth sitting with.

IDENTITY SLOT

When the Chief Justice of India called unemployed young people cockroaches and parasites, the next morning there was a graphic reading Main Bhi Cockroach, and within four days the account carrying it had more followers than the BJP.

India is not short of identities on offer. Religion, caste, class, region, language, are all older than the republic and all contested. The cockroach is keyed to none of them. To claim it you need nothing except to be online. Put the emoji in your bio and you are in.

Note the direction, though. Our defining insult pointed up. Nepo kid was the youth naming the elite. In India, it came down from the Chief Justice, the elite naming the youth as vermin, and it was caught in mid-air and worn. What a catch.

ENDINGS DIFFER

None of this explains why one movement took a government and the other only took a minister.

Leaderlessness does. A movement with nobody at its head cannot be negotiated with. It can only be survived or fled from, and K P Oli fled. India’s Cockroaches had a founder who is a professional communications strategist, a manifesto, named spokespersons. On 24 July they sat down with two union ministers. On the 25th Dharmendra Pradhan resigned. That evening they went home.

State capacity matters a lot. Nepal also banned 26 platforms before the protest, India withheld one account and got a replacement titled Cockroach Is Back, with a bio saying ‘cockroaches do not die’.

Delhi had watched Dhaka in 2024 and Kathmandu in 2025 and drawn the obvious conclusion that a ‘GenZ’ movement handled badly does not stay a student movement. Its police were trained for a job ours had never expected to do.

Photo: WIKIMEDIA COMMONS

SCAPEGOAT

René Girard argued that a community in crisis resolves it by converging on a single victim. Expel him and peace returns, while whatever caused the crisis stays exactly where it was.

We do this constantly. A rural road washes out in the first monsoon after it is blacktopped. The district engineer is suspended, his name runs in the papers, the anger has somewhere to go. The contractor who has won that tender for a decade bids again in the autumn. Nobody suspends the procurement process. That is the scapegoat, to redirect people’s anger towards a person instead of a system.

A memetic movement is unusually good at producing a mimetic scapegoat, because both run on imitation. A meme is imitation that spreads. A scapegoat is imitation that converges. The format wants one face in the frame.

You could meme the National Testing Agency, but you cannot scapegoat it. It is too abstract a structure. You can meme a minister, and you can scapegoat him. Done and dusted. Guyz, the education minister resigned, all problems fixed! Not.

Pradhan is gone. The leak that made 2.2 million Indian students sit the same exam twice is not addressed by his absence. Neither is the education policy, nor the revolving door between the bench and the Cabinet that the CJP named in its own manifesto. The sacrifice worked and that is exactly the problem.

FROM HERE

I only know the Indian protest through what my Meta™ Dalal chose to hand me. It is possible I only saw the memes.

But I know what the week after feels like. We got our scapegoat in three days. We burned down Parliament, cremated our dead, and we elected a prime minister who is better at Facebook than anyone else in South Asia. Ten months on, the grievance that put us on the street is intact.

A resignation is a receipt, not a reform. My message to GenZ Indians: Ride the wave. Then, watch the next exam cycle instead of the next trend.

काठमांडू केरऽ एगो क्लिप, सितम्बर २०२५. दस महीना बाद इएह फ्रेम भारतीय फीड मे फैन आर्ट के रूप मे घूमि रहल अछि, जकरा फेर सं रंगल गेल अछि आ कैप्शन देल गेल अछि: चलू भारतीय जेनजेड.

कोकरोच जनता पार्टी सहित भारत मे भले बहुतो लोक ई कहबाक प्रयास केने छथि जे एहि मास ओतय जे भेल से नेपाल, बांग्लादेश या श्रीलंका सं मौलिक रूप सं अलग अछि, एकर समानांतर सेहो अछि. खास क' मीम के दुनिया मे।

रील के कई विधा सीमा पार चलि गेल अछि। एकटा मे एकटा भारतीय रचनाकार नेपालीक नागरिक भावना केँ अपनहि देशक असफलताक प्रमाणक रूप मे प्रशंसा करैत काठमांडू मे घुमैत छथि ।

दोसर मे एकटा नेपाली निर्माता पोखरा फुटपाथ पर खाना बनाबय वाला भारतीय पर्यटक के फिल्मांकन करैत भारतीय पर्यटक के नेपाल के प्रदूषित करय के सबूत के रूप मे ऊपर उठबैत छथि.

विपरीत दिशा स इएह संदेश आबि रहल अछि। दुनू एकहि काज करैत छथि — पोखरा घुमैत एकटा खास तरहक भारतीय सामग्री निर्माता पर्यटक लेल नेपाल मात्र पड़ोसी नहि अपितु फीड मे संदर्भ छवि अछि ।

सितम्बर २०२५ मे छहत्तरि नेपालीके मृत्यु भेल छल ।दिल्लीक भाकपा विरोधमे लाठी, आंसू गैस, हिरासत आ २६ दिनक अनशन भेल छल, मुदा पहिने दर्जनों आत्महत्याक दोष नीट परीक्षा पत्र लीक भेलाक कारणेँ ककरो मृत्यु नहि भेल छल ।

हमरा जे रुचि अछि ओ अछि व्यापारिक मार्ग। भारत मे नेपालक वास्तविक निर्यात वीरगंज होइत चलि जाइत अछि । कस्टम मे कतार मे लागि जाइत छथि, तौलैत छथि, पाइ दैत छथि, आ प्रतीक्षा करैत छथि। लेकिन एक इंस्टाग्राम रील एक सेकंड के अंश में पार होय जाय छै, कोनो ड्यूटी नै दै छै, कोनो ट्रांजिट एग्रीमेंट के जरूरत नै छै, आरू रक्सौल के खाली करी दै छै, बिना सीमा पर केकरो ई पता चलै कि ई घटित होय गेलऽ छै.

एकमात्र पार्टी जे कट लैत अछि ओ अछि दलाल - मेटाTM। आ मेटा साहब एकरा रुपैया स बेसी ध्यान मे लैत अछि। भारत आरू नेपाल के बीच आभासी सीमा पर ई सबसें कुशल तस्कर छै, आरू उत्पाद मीम आरू मीम फॉर्मेट के छै ।

सितंबर के विरोध के दौरान हम एकटा मीम बनेलहुं जे 'पहिने एक दोसरा में केकरा रुचि छल?' टिकटॉक आवाज, सामान्यतः एकटा जोड़ी के बिट, दंगा पुलिस के लाइन के खिलाफ. लगभग 20 लाख व्यूज केलक। एहि गर्मी मे भारतीय फीड पर सेहो इएह आवाज आयल, ओही निशाना दिस इशारा केलक।

हम एहि मे स एकटा बनेलहुं, ताहि लेल हमरा ठीक स पता अछि जे एहि मे कतेक कम मेहनत लगैत अछि आ कतेक दूर तक पहुंचैत अछि। सबवे सर्फर्स चेस एडिट सेहो पार भ गेल। तहिना पानिक तोप सेहो। मीम के मतलब छै कि साझा करलऽ जाय, रीमिक्स करलऽ जाय, आरू पुनः वितरित करलऽ जाय । तइयो कोन मीम के पुनर्वितरण, रीमिक्स या शेयर कयल जाइत अछि से लाइक, कमेंट या शेयर स बेसी किछु बताबैत अछि।

समन एवं अभ्यास

नेपाल मे मीम देखाबय के छल, आओर बेसी देखाबय के बाद बनल छल. पानिक तोप के सामने आभा गोली चलल। जरैत भवनक विरुद्ध सिल्हूट। सबसँ बेसी जे पसरल छल ओ छल आगमनक फुटेज, जतय नहि हेबाक चाही छल ओतय उपस्थित लाशक। हमर मीम एकटा समन छल।

दिल्ली मे जंतर मंतर मे सेहो बहुत रास छल। मुदा दोसर परत छल। भारतीय मीम सेहो चकमा देबय के छल: पानिक तोप कोना लेब, लूपहोल खोजब जाहि सं पुलिस अहां के नहिं मारि सकय. एकटा मीम फिल्मक दृश्य जकाँ काटल गेल छल, जकर कैप्शन छल: ‘मी एट द प्रोटेस्ट सेविंग ए 10/10 बैडी फ्रॉम द वाटर कैनन’, जाहि मे एकटा नायक नायिका केँ वाटर कैनन सँ साफ खींचैत देखाओल गेल छल, जाहि सँ ओकरा राज्यक हिंसा सँ बचाओल गेल छल.

पड़ोसी के देखला स इएह भेटैत अछि। भारत के युवा न सिर्फ हमरऽ मीम के नकल नै करलकै, बल्कि हमरऽ फुटेज के अध्ययन करी क॑ ई काम करलकै कि सरकार के खिलाफ विरोध करै लेली वास्तव म॑ की जरूरी छै ।

वेशभूषा एवं निशान

जंतर मंतर मे सुपरमैन, स्पाइडर मैन आ कम स कम एकटा टी-रेक्स छल। एकरा म॑ महात्मा गांधी केरऽ कपड़ा पहिनलऽ एगो आदमी न॑ ‘वाइल्ड कार्ड एंट्री’ के कैप्शन देल॑ छेलै, ई मजाक प॑ कि हालात एतना खराब होय गेलऽ छै कि गांधी मृतकऽ स॑ वापस आबी क॑ विरोध करलकै । ओहि पोस्ट के छह लाख लाइक भेटल। लोक प्लेकार्ड के रूप मे छपल मीम ल क चलैत छल।

काठमांडू मे खोपड़ी-हड्डी आ भूसाक टोपी छल। जंतर मंतर पर भूसाक टोपी आबि गेल, मुदा पाहुनक रूप मे। ओ सभ मेजबान भाषा नहि छल। वेशभूषा में उपस्थिति अलग-अलग बिट छल, प्रत्येक के अपन पोस्ट, प्रत्येक दोसर के संग प्रतिस्पर्धा करैत छल.

आभा अर्थव्यवस्था

एकर एकटा नाम अछि आभा खेती। ई आन्दोलन के लेल काज करैत अछि, कच्चा संभव तरीका स। विरोध के रुझान पर एक अपमानजनक वेशभूषा। ट्रेंडिंग कर्षण लाबैत अछि। कर्षण अगिला भीड़ ल क अबैत अछि। मजाक भार-भारी अछि।

देखू, एकर की खर्च होइत छैक, तथापि। टी-रेक्स ओहि चीज के समतल क दैत अछि जे ओ भीतर ठाढ़ अछि। जंतर मंतर मे जे भेल से एकटा एहन पीढ़ी छल जे एकटा एहन व्यवस्था क खिलाफ विद्रोह केलक जे ओकरा सालों स असफल क रहल अछि आ अपन किछु साथी कए दफना देलक। वेशभूषा मे एकर फोटो पाबनि के रूप मे लेल जाइत अछि । आ कोनो महोत्सव देखि पहुंचय वाला लोक एकटा फिल्माबय लेल अबैत छथिन्ह.

हमरा बुझने ई बुझब जरूरी अछि जे हम सब कम आंकि लैत छी जे युवा कतेक खराब तरीका स’ वायरल होबय चाहैत छथि. कोनो जेन-अल्फा बच्चा सं पूछू जे ओ पैघ भेला पर की बनय चाहैत छथि - ओ बेसी संभावना जे व्लॉगर, यूट्यूबर, या गेमर कहताह. एहि सप्ताह रंग-बिरंगक रेनकोट मे स्कूल सं चलैत तीन टा नेपाली टॉट्स के टिकटॉक पर फिल्मायल गेल, वायरल भ गेल, आओर हुनका सभ के छात्रवृत्ति देल गेल.

वायरलिटी आब मात्र सामाजिक पूंजी नहि रहि गेल अछि। ई एकटा काज करय वाला आर्थिक साधन अछि, आ बहुत रास युवा के लेल ई एकमात्र एहन साधन अछि जे बिना कनेक्शन के उपलब्ध अछि.

ओहि खींचतान सं लोक कैमरा के सामने नाचय लागय छथिन्ह. एहि सं हुनका लाइवकैम पर अपमानजनक बात कहय पड़ैत छनि. ई कियैक नहि जे पिछला मास संसाद मार्ग पर कियो मार्च केने छल आ कि पिछला साल बनसवॉर मे. मुदा ई कतहु मिक्स मे छल, जे हमर पीढ़ी के बारे मे किछु बताबैत अछि जे संग बैसय लायक अछि.

पहचान स्लॉट

भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जखन बेरोजगार युवा सब के तिलचट्टा आ परजीवी कहलखिन त दोसर दिन भोरे एकटा ग्राफिक लिखल छल जे मैं भी तिलचट्टा छल, आ चारि दिन के भीतर एकरा ल क चलय वाला खाता के भाजपा स बेसी फॉलोअर्स भ गेल।

भारत मे ऑफर मे पहचान क कमी नहि अछि। धर्म, जाति, वर्ग, क्षेत्र, भाषा, सब गणतंत्र स पुरान अछि आ सब विवादित अछि । तिलचट्टा कोनो मे सँ कोनो मे चाभी नहि लागल अछि। एकर दावा करय लेल अहां के ऑनलाइन रहय के अलावा किछ के जरूरत नहिं. इमोजी अपन बायो में राखू आ अहाँ में छी।

दिशा पर ध्यान दियौक, तथापि। हमर परिभाषित अपमान ऊपर इशारा केलक। नेपो किड अभिजात वर्ग के नाम लेबय वाला युवा छल. भारत मे ई मुख्य न्यायाधीश सँ उतरल छल, अभिजात वर्ग युवा के कीड़ा-मकोड़ा कहैत छल, आ एकरा हवा मे पकड़ि क' पहिरल गेल छल. केहन पकड़ल गेल।

अंत अलग-अलग होइत अछि

एहि मे सँ कोनो बात ई नहि बुझा सकैत अछि जे एकटा आन्दोलन सरकार किएक लेलक आ दोसर मात्र मंत्री केँ लेलक।

नेतृत्वहीनता करैत अछि। जकर माथ पर ककरो नहि हो आन्दोलन सँ बातचीत नहि कयल जा सकैत अछि । एकरा मात्र बचल जा सकैत अछि वा भागल जा सकैत अछि, आ के पी ओली भागि गेल। भारत केरऽ तिलचट्टा केरऽ एगो संस्थापक छेलै जे एगो पेशेवर संचार रणनीतिकार छै, एगो घोषणापत्र, नामित प्रवक्ता । 24 जुलाई कए ओ दूटा केंद्रीय मंत्री क संग बैसलाह। 25 तारीख के धर्मेन्द्र प्रधान इस्तीफा द देलखिन्ह. ओहि साँझ ओ सभ घर चलि गेलाह।

राज्यक क्षमता बहुत मायने रखैत अछि। नेपाल विरोध प्रदर्शन स पहिने 26 प्लेटफॉर्म पर सेहो रोक लगा देलक, भारत एकटा खाता रोकलक आ ओकर जगह पर कोकरोच इज बैक नामक एकटा खाता भेटल, जाहि मे एकटा बायो मे लिखल छल जे ‘कोकरोच नहि मरैत अछि’।

दिल्ली न॑ २०२४ म॑ ढाका आरू २०२५ म॑ काठमांडू क॑ देखन॑ छेलै आरू ई स्पष्ट निष्कर्ष निकाललकै कि खराब तरीका स॑ संभाललऽ गेलऽ ‘जेनजेड’ आन्दोलन छात्र आन्दोलन नै रह॑ छै । एकर पुलिस एहन काज लेल प्रशिक्षित छल जेकर उम्मीद हमरा सबहक कहियो नहि छल।

फोटो: विकिमीडिया कॉमन

बलिदान के बकरा

रेने गिरार्ड केरऽ तर्क छेलै कि संकट म॑ पड़लऽ समुदाय एकरऽ समाधान एक ही पीड़ित प॑ अभिसरण करी क॑ करै छै । ओकरा भगा दियौक आ शांति वापस आबि जाइत छैक, जखन कि जे किछु संकट के कारण बनल से ठीक ओतहि रहैत छैक जतय छलैक।

हम सब निरंतर ई काज करैत छी। एकटा ग्रामीण सड़क ब्लैकटॉप के बाद पहिल मानसून में बहैत अछि. जिला अभियंता निलंबित अछि, कागज मे ओकर नाम दौड़ैत अछि, तामस के कतहु जाय के अछि। जे ठेकेदार एक दशक स ओहि टेंडर कए जीत चुकल अछि ओ शरद ऋतु मे फेर स बोली लगा दैत अछि। खरीद प्रक्रिया कए कियो निलंबित नहि करैत अछि। ओ अछि बलि के बकरा, लोकक क्रोध केँ कोनो व्यवस्थाक बदला कोनो व्यक्ति दिस पुनर्निर्देशित करब.

मेमेटिक आन्दोलन नकल बलि के बकरा के उत्पादन में असामान्य रूप स नीक होइत अछि, कारण दुनू नकल पर चलैत अछि । मीम नकल होइत अछि जे पसरैत अछि। बलि के बकरा नकल छै जे अभिसरण करै छै। प्रारूप फ्रेम मे एकटा चेहरा चाहैत अछि।

अहां नेशनल टेस्टिंग एजेंसी के मीम क सकय छी, मुदा ओकरा बलि के बकरा नहिं बना सकय छी. ई बेसी अमूर्त संरचना अछि। कोनो मंत्री के मीम क सकैत छी, आ ओकरा बलि के बकरा बना सकैत छी। कयल आ धूल-धूसरित। गाइज, शिक्षा मंत्री इस्तीफा द देलखिन, सब समस्या ठीक भ गेल! नहि।

प्रधान चलि गेलाह। 22 लाख भारतीय छात्र दू बेर एकहि परीक्षा मे बैसय वाला लीक के हुनकर अनुपस्थिति सं संबोधित नहिं कएल जा सकैत अछि. ने शिक्षा नीति अछि, आ ने पीठ आ मंत्रिमंडल के बीच घुमावदार दरवाजा जेकर नाम भाजपा अपन घोषणापत्र मे रखने छल। त्याग काज केलक आ ठीक वैह समस्या अछि।

एतय सँ

भारतीय विरोध के हम केवल ओहि माध्यम स जनैत छी जे हमर मेटाTM दलाल हमरा हाथ मे देबय लेल चुनलनि। संभव अछि जे हम मात्र मीम देखलहुं।

मुदा ओकर बादक सप्ताह केहन होइत छैक से हमरा बुझल अछि। तीन दिन मे हमरा लोकनि केँ अपन बलि-बकरी भेटि गेल। हम संसद के जरा देलियैक, अपन मृतक के अंतिम संस्कार केलहुं, आ एकटा एहन प्रधानमंत्री चुनलहुं जे दक्षिण एशिया के सब सं नीक फेसबुक पर नीक छथि. दस मास बाद जे शिकायत हमरा सब कए सड़क पर उतारलक ओ अक्षुण्ण अछि।

इस्तीफा रसीद होइत छैक, सुधार नहि। जेनजेड भारतीय के लेल हमर संदेश : लहर के सवारी करू। तखन, अगिला ट्रेंड के जगह अगिला परीक्षा चक्र देखू.
